author: Glam-invites
title: Extremely Frustrating Energy System
content:
Title: Extremely Frustrating Energy System

The game design is extremely disappointing. It feels like the entire structure is designed to constantly push players to buy energy or diamonds if they want to play for more than five minutes.

You earn only 1 energy point per minute, and you can accumulate a maximum of 100 points. That 100 energy can easily be used up in five minutes or less, sometimes even in just a couple of minutes when completing a complicated dish. Then you’re forced to wait over an hour and a half just to accumulate another 100 energy.

If you want to keep playing instead of waiting, the game essentially forces you to spend money. This creates a frustrating cycle: play for a few minutes, run out of energy, wait for over an hour, or pay to continue.

The game itself could be fun, but this energy system completely ruins the experience. It feels less like a game designed for enjoyment and more like a system designed to drain players’ money. There should be a much more reasonable balance between gameplay, energy regeneration, and purchases.
